Name: (AT) More Bearz
Author: catmoss
Description:
[size=4][b]Features:[/b]
[/size]
A handful more bear options for the large futan bear. <3 
We got dark and light brown, we got cute fruit like peach, strawberry, orange and blueberry, we got emo, hell we got weed (blunt included).
I'll most likely make more but for now this is all I got. If anyone has suggestions on a bear theme feel free to drop it in the comments :]
